featured_reviews.name: Asim Yadav
featured_reviews.review_text:
Overall, the movie experience at PVR Le Reve was disappointing. The only reason to pick is the convenience for people staying in Bandra West.

Specifically, avoid booking the A row (last row) seats as they do not recline at all, which makes them quite uncomfortable for a long movie. On top of that, the air conditioning was poor and felt like it wasn’t fully switched on, making the auditorium stuffy throughout the show.

featured_reviews.name: Pervin Dumasia
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely bad experience with the food n beverage.  Ordered for almost 1000/- rupees--for a single person.  Was served stale samosas. Feeling unwell after a few hours due to this. The coffee was so bad and not what I had ordered. The coffee was replaced---but even that was lackluster and very tasteless. Complained to the manager--chandresh-- who was not trained well enough to address the situation.

After charging so exhorbitantly( for just popcorn, coffee n samosas )---it is a shame that such sub standard food is served to patrons. I am a very tolerant person,  and rarely complain--but this was too much of cheating of customers.

Truly upset and disappointed with PVR.  The relevant authorities need to check their kitchen.  Been to many PVR  theaters before,  including this one---and although the food was never great, it was atleast not so blatantly bad.

featured_reviews.name: Mayur Aundhakar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Maxus Cinemas on Gorai Road, Borivali West recently. Overall, the experience was decent, but there are a few areas that need improvement.

The biggest disappointment was that the movie started almost 30 minutes late, which was quite frustrating and affected the overall experience. The management should ensure better punctuality and timely show schedules.

The theatre is clean and the seating is comfortable. Food quality was surprisingly good, with decent options available and fresh snacks. However, the sound quality was slightly below expectations. The audio lacked depth and could definitely be improved for a better cinematic experience.

Despite these issues, the ambience is pleasant and it's still a good option for a casual movie outing with friends and family. Hoping they improve the sound system and maintain better show timings in the future.

⭐⭐⭐☆☆ (3/5)

featured_reviews.name: Dj Anu
featured_reviews.review_text:
Honestly, really disappointed with my experience at Maxsus Cinema. The picture quality was extremely poor — the screen looked blurry, as if the sharpness wasn’t even set properly. For a premium theatre, this is just unacceptable.

On top of that, the audio was even worse. The speakers were crackling throughout, completely ruining the movie experience. Instead of immersive sound, it felt like sitting next to a broken speaker system.

Even the food was a letdown. The ₹100 sandwich was pathetic — dry, swaggy, and didn’t even have proper butter applied. Completely not worth the price.

Overall, not worth the money at all. Definitely expected much better from a brand like this.

featured_reviews.review_text: Overall Experience is Good, Seats are comfortable but some reclining seats not working properly. featured_reviews.name: Anish Gandhi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Maxus Theatre, Borivali offers a consistently enjoyable movie-watching experience. The ambience is pleasant, seating is comfortable, and the overall layout of the theatre is well maintained, making it a great place to unwind and enjoy a film.
Audio and visual quality are impressive, with clear sound and sharp screen projection that enhance the cinematic experience. Cleanliness is well taken care of across the premises, including the seating areas and washrooms, which adds to the comfort.

Staff are courteous and helpful, and the entry and exit process is smooth without unnecessary delays. The food counter offers decent options, and service is efficient even during peak hours.

Overall, Maxus Theatre stands out as a reliable and comfortable theatre in Borivali, ideal for family outings as well as casual movie plans. Definitely a good choice for a hassle-free movie experience.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing this review to document a serious food safety incident at PVR, Jio World Plaza, BKC.

On 15 January 2026, I attended the 6:00 PM show of Avatar 3 in Audi 6. Before the movie, I purchased food from the PVR counter. While eating it during the show, the final bite contained a visible piece of glass that entered my mouth. I immediately spat it out. The fact that I was not physically injured was purely a matter of luck, this could have caused severe internal injury or worse.

I have video evidence clearly showing the glass shard in the food.

What has been equally disturbing is the way this matter has been handled since. Despite multiple emails, follow-ups, and assurances that the issue was being taken seriously, there were significant delays, inconsistent communication, and ultimately a response stating that no lapse could be established at their end. The only gesture initially offered was complimentary movie tickets, which is entirely inappropriate for a life-threatening food safety incident.

As a paying customer, being exposed to such a risk and then experiencing weeks of delay and deflection has been deeply distressing. This review is being posted so that other patrons are aware and so that this concern is documented publicly after private escalation failed to lead to a responsible resolution.

I hope PVR reviews its food safety accountability and customer handling practices more seriously going forward.

Visited Jio PVR recently for an evening weekday show. The theatre itself was extremely clean, the seats were very comfortable, and the cooling was VERY strong — honestly, carry a jacket if you’re planning to watch a movie there because it gets quite cold inside. The overall ambience and maintenance were excellent.

Ticket pricing between ₹250–₹500 feels reasonable considering the cleanliness and comfort, especially if booked smartly on weekdays.

But as usual with PVR, the food pricing is absurd. Ordered a ₹350 Schezwan Paneer Wrap and it was a complete waste of money. The taste was terrible and definitely not worth the price. They serve it properly with a tray, plate, and cutlery, but realistically, how convenient is that setup inside a movie theatre while watching a film in the dark?

Popcorn and drinks are also heavily overpriced, and the quantity doesn’t justify the cost either.

Overall: great theatre experience for seating, cleanliness, and ambience — but avoid spending too much on the food unless you’re okay paying premium prices for average quality.

The attention to historical authenticity in sets, costumes, and performances reflected Manikarnika Films’ commitment to excellence.

Beyond grandeur, the company’s philosophy emphasizes meaningful cinema over commercial compromise. Kangana has repeatedly voiced her intent to nurture new talent—writers, directors, and technicians—through her banner, encouraging fresh voices in Indian cinema. Her later projects under Manikarnika Films, such as Tiku Weds Sheru, further showcase her willingness to experiment with genres while maintaining artistic integrity.

In essence, Manikarnika Films is not just a production house—it’s a statement of creative freedom, self-reliance, and national pride. featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Metro INOX Cinema, and my overall experience was extremely enjoyable and comfortable. This cinema hall perfectly blends a classic feel with modern movie-watching amenities, making it a great choice for both regular viewers and cinema lovers who appreciate a well-maintained theatre.

The screen and sound quality were excellent. The visuals were sharp, bright, and immersive, which made the movie even more engaging. The sound system was well balanced—loud enough to create impact without being overwhelming. Dialogues were clear, and background music and effects were crisp, enhancing the overall cinematic experience.

The seating arrangement deserves special mention. The seats were comfortable, well-spaced, and offered a clear view of the screen from almost every angle. Legroom was sufficient, allowing for a relaxed experience even during a long movie. The auditorium was clean and well maintained, which added to the comfort level.

The ambience of Metro INOX has a pleasant and premium feel. The lobby area was neat, organized, and not overly crowded. The lighting and interiors give a classy vibe, making the wait time before the show quite comfortable. Entry and exit were well managed, avoiding unnecessary rush or confusion.

Food and beverages were also satisfactory. The snacks counter offered the usual cinema favourites like popcorn, cold drinks, and nachos. While prices are on the higher side—as expected in multiplexes—the quality and freshness were good. The staff at the counter were polite and quick in handling orders, even during peak hours.

Another positive aspect was the staff behavior and overall management. The staff members were helpful, courteous, and ensured smooth operations throughout the show. Ticket checking, seating guidance, and cleanliness were handled efficiently. Restrooms were clean and well maintained, which is an important factor for any public place.

Overall, Metro INOX Cinema provides a reliable, comfortable, and enjoyable movie-watching experience. Whether you’re going for a weekend show with friends, a family outing, or a solo movie break, this place delivers on quality, comfort, and ambience. I would definitely recommend Metro INOX Cinema to anyone looking for a pleasant and hassle-free cinema experience.

featured_reviews.review_text: Metro INOX at Marine Lines is a standout cinema that beautifully blends Art Deco heritage with modern luxury, offering a visual treat before the movie even starts. The viewing experience is top-tier, featuring crisp Laser projection and immersive Dolby Atmos sound, while the Insignia screens provide unmatched comfort with recliner seating and butler service. However, this premium experience comes with South Mumbai pricing for tickets and food, and the biggest drawback is the severe lack of parking, often forcing patrons to use distant pay-and-park slots. Overall, it is a perfect spot for a lavish movie date or a special night out if you arrive by cab, but a logistical headache if you plan to drive.

featured_reviews.review_text:
The place was extremely unhygienic. As soon as we entered, there was a strong smell of shoes, which was very unpleasant and unbearable. When we went to the counter, we ordered coffee and popcorn. featured_reviews.name: Rohit Srivastava
featured_reviews.review_text: It's not a Mall anymore only Globus PVR. The closest place in Bandra for movies. But really a renovated old theatre that was originally famously known as New Talkies. So I am taking you down history lane. I and a friend bunked college to watch movies here every week in 1988-1990, and occasionally later too. It was famous for playing new movies every week at prices that were the lowest. 5-7 rupee stall tickets and 15 rupees balcony. Movies that didn't play elsewhere like the entire Jackie Chan series could be found here. I even watched Predator here. So it has memories. PVR has renovated it to a modern screen. Parking is limited inside but the Valet is helpful in taking care of that issue. So enjoy the movies without going to far.

featured_reviews.name: Annapurna Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
Globus Mall is a cozy spot for a laid-back shopping experience. It’s not the biggest or flashiest mall, but that’s part of its charm. The atmosphere is bright and inviting, making it a nice place to wander around for a few hours.

When it comes to shopping, Globus Mall has a decent mix of stores, mainly focusing on fashion and lifestyle products. You might not find all the big brand names here, but there are plenty of trendy and affordable options, especially if you’re looking to update your wardrobe without spending too much.

The food court is on the smaller side but has a good variety of options, perfect for grabbing a quick bite in between shopping. Whether you’re in the mood for some fast food or something a bit more substantial, you’ll find something to satisfy your hunger.

Overall, Globus Mall offers a more relaxed and casual shopping experience. It’s not the place for an all-day shopping spree, but it’s great for a quick trip or a casual outing. If you’re in the area and want to shop in a comfortable, less crowded environment, Globus Mall is worth a visit.

First thing, people were continuously coming and going during the movie. Like no one cared what scene is going on. Full disturbance.
Second, the crowd was very noisy. People were talking loudly as if they are sitting at home. No basic theatre manners.
Phones ringing everywhere 📱

There were many kids also, shouting and making noise. Couldn’t focus on the movie at all.
At one point, people even started fighting. That was the moment I was like… what is happening bro 😭
Overall, it didn’t feel like I came to watch a movie.
It felt like I came to watch public chaos.

Not recommended if you want peace and actually enjoy a movie.

featured_reviews.name: Kartike
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very disappointing experience at Maratha Mandir theatre. The balcony seats were not comfortable and did not provide a good viewing experience. The AC was also not working properly, which made the environment quite uncomfortable during the show.

The sound quality was below average and the screen clarity was not up to the mark either, which affected the overall movie experience. To make it worse, the snacks options were very limited — only a few basic items like chips and samosas were available.

Overall, the visit did not meet expectations at all. The theatre really needs improvement in seating comfort, maintenance, sound, and food variety to offer a better experience to visitors.

Vijay Sir's work transcends the title of cinematographer. He's an artist who breathes life into every frame. Witnessing his ability to capture the essence of a scene, the emotions, the unspoken words, is truly humbling.

But beyond his technical brilliance, what truly shines is Vijay sir as the person. His passion for storytelling and his willingness to mentor are infectious. To learn under his guidance would be an honour, an opportunity to grow not just as a cinematographer, but as a storyteller myself. He's an amazing person to work with, highly recommend!

featured_reviews.name: Faraz Shere

Vijay Mishra, bas naam hi kaafi hai aur naam toh suna hi hoga😎

A dearest friend, an exceptionally kind person, and among the most diligent and gifted DoP I have ever seen in my professional life of 25 long years. One of Vijay Bhai's greatest qualities is his unwavering readiness and unending energy, even if the shoot extends to 24/36 hours, which is why he is the director and producer's favourite. To be very truthful, he is directors delight.

Everyone is eager to work with Vijay Mishra and is willing to wait weeks or months for his dates. For me, he has gained the respect and affection of hundreds of people, even though what he has gained today may be money and celebrity for many.

Lots of luck, love & dua for you Vijay bhai, allways! ❤️💕

featured_reviews.name: Naihrit Halder
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Eros IMAX, Mumbai, and it ended up being one of my favourite movie experiences in the city. There’s something special about this place—the moment you see the iconic art‑deco building from outside, it already feels different from the typical multiplex vibe.
Inside, the theatre is spacious, clean, and surprisingly comfortable. The IMAX screen here genuinely enhances the movie experience without overwhelming you, and the sound quality is crystal clear. I watched a film here recently, and the visuals + audio made it feel so immersive.
One thing I really appreciate about Eros is how well-organized everything is—from the ticket counters to entering the auditorium. The staff was polite and helpful, and the crowd felt more relaxed compared to the usual rush you see in other cinemas.
Snacks are priced reasonably for a theatre in South Mumbai, and the washrooms and waiting areas are clean and well-maintained.
Plus, walking out after the show into the Churchgate/Marine Drive area just completes the whole experience. It’s one of the few cinemas where both the movie and the location feel equally enjoyable.
Definitely a great spot for movie lovers. I’d happily visit again!

featured_reviews.name: ARYAN PATIL
featured_reviews.review_text: Watched a movie at Eros INOX and had a great experience overall. The screen quality is excellent with sharp visuals, and the sound system is immersive, making the movie truly engaging. Seating is comfortable with good legroom, so even long movies feel relaxed. The theatre is clean, well maintained, and the staff is organized, which makes entry and exit smooth. Definitely one of the better places in the city to enjoy a movie.

featured_reviews.name: Arjun Pitroda
featured_reviews.review_text: Had an incredible experience at Eros INOX! I’ve watched two IMAX movies here recently and both were spectacular. The restoration is stunning—they’ve kept the classic Art Deco charm and those iconic marble stairs, but the theater itself is world-class. The IMAX with Laser technology is super sharp, and the sound is immersive without being overwhelming. It’s easily one of the best places in Mumbai to catch a blockbuster. Highly recommend for the nostalgia and the tech!

featured_reviews.name: Yash Popat
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Stunning Revival of a Mumbai Icon!

I recently visited the newly revamped Eros Theatre at Churchgate, now under the PVR banner and featuring a grand IMAX screen. I must say, the experience was nothing short of spectacular.

The restoration has beautifully retained the Art Deco charm of this iconic building, blending heritage with modern technology seamlessly. From the moment you enter, the space exudes elegance and nostalgia, yet feels fresh and world-class.

The IMAX screen is massive and immersive, and the sound system is crystal clear, delivering every note and dialogue with incredible depth. Seats are comfortable, the ambience is premium, and the entire setup does justice to both classic cinema lovers and modern moviegoers.

Kudos to PVR for respecting the legacy of Eros while transforming it into a state-of-the-art cinema destination. If you’re in Mumbai and love movies, this place is an absolute must-visit!

featured_reviews.name: Musafir Hun Yaaron
featured_reviews.review_text: Eros Cinema, a landmark in Mumbai’s Churchgate area, first opened its doors in 1938, showcasing exquisite Art Deco architecture designed by Shorabji Bhedwar.  After ceasing operations in 2017, this iconic theater underwent extensive renovations and reopened in February 2024 as Eros INOX IMAX, Mumbai’s first standalone IMAX with Laser theatre.  The transformation seamlessly blends the original architectural charm with state-of-the-art cinematic technology, offering audiences an immersive viewing experience. The revamped cinema now features a 305-seat IMAX auditorium on the second floor, while preserving the historic facade and grand foyer, symbolizing a harmonious fusion of heritage and modernity.
